intro.title: Hart County Solid Waste
intro.description: Managing eight convenience centers and the county transfer station through a pay-as-you-throw disposal system.

service_notice: The Hart County Transfer Station will not accept recyclables beginning January 12 until further notice due to repairs. Please take recyclable materials to a convenience center.
overview: Household trash must be placed in special bags purchased at convenience centers throughout Hart County.
Trash and larger items may also be taken to the transfer station, where disposal charges are based on weight.
disposal_alternatives: Paint may be disposed of after it has completely dried. Sand or cat litter may be used to dry paint in its container.
Tires are accepted in a separate disposal area for a fee.

rates.title: Recyclables
rates.detail: Collected and disposed of free of charge at convenience centers.

rates.title: Yard Waste
rates.detail: $45 per ton for Hart County residents; $60 per ton for non-residents.

rates.title: Tipping Fees
rates.detail: $60 per ton for Hart County residents; $120 per ton for non-residents.

payment_notice: Yard waste is ground into mulch, available free in three-yard scoops. Payment is by cash or check only; debit and credit cards are not accepted.

metal_recyclers.text: The Hart County Sheriff's Office handles metal-recycler registrations. Submit the completed registration form to the Sheriff's Office at 890 Vickery Street in Hartwell.
